risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/bootstrap.ts, apps/api/src/modules/platform/http/**): Cache-Control: no-store by default on responses to requests that carry a verified identity (D10-396 ③, 规划/03 §8.3, couli #213). In createHttpApp's global onSend hook, next to X-Trace-Id and without an entry switch, applyNoStore writes no-store when the request has the principal / adminPrincipal carriers attached by the request checks (only the verified objects, never request headers) and the response has no Cache-Control yet. This covers the api, stream and admin HTTP entries, error envelopes from the global filter and bodiless responses. Anonymous requests and routes that set Cache-Control themselves are left alone. No money, ledger or database change. Rule tests by a fresh independent Claude (approvals #36), red PASS on the spec commit (11 red, 0 problems). Implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run. verify:fast in the test-machine container exit 0. Full verify on the test machine (verify/1): exit 124 at the 3600 s limit with no failing case before it; no-store entries / identity / real-routes 11/11 passed; recorded per D10-319, CI verify-int is the check.
